== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34577) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Brown LS Obi Communing.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>e7ad49e7e663466b57a80021e30132840d334df6ea51c96d8ccce261756e867a</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Jyn Erso (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>206_4^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Padmé Naberrie (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>203_36</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Padme Naberrie (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
* 1x [[Coruscant: Jedi Temple (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>219_31^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>216_26^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>216_43^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
